messages:
sasha: Heads-up — noticed confusing behavior in console quicksave for route-level filters when model-specific filters are present. Saved query seemed to drop model filters when I switched routes.

jun: can you repro? which route/model?

sasha: repro steps: open route A (route_id=payments), select model=redwood-encoder-v1, add filter "status:failed", save query as "failed-payments". Switch to route B and load saved query. Model filter removed, only route-scoped filters applied.

marta: hmm expected saved query to be stable and carry model scope unless explicitly set to route-scope. Are we mixing 'view scope' with 'filter scope'?

ryan: current design: saved queries have scope enum {global, route, model, ephemeral}. When loading, we merge saved filters with active route/model defaults. Merge order: route defaults -> saved filters -> model defaults. That causes saved model filters to be overwritten by route defaults if they share keys.

sasha: that's surprising — users expect saved query to be authoritative. Can we flip merge order so saved filters override route/model defaults? At least for filters with explicit model attribute.

jun: two risks: telemetry and quota. Changing merge order might change token burn for some previews and break canary rollouts. Also saved queries used in dashboard snapshots assume route merges.

marta: Proposal: add explicit field in saved query metadata: "apply_strategy": "strict" | "merge_prefer_saved" | "merge_prefer_route". Default keeps current behavior to avoid regressions. UI shows small badge "saved query apply: strict" on load with hover tooltip.

ryan: backend impact: small. API add attribute to POST /saved_queries. Default null -> existing legacy path. Add migration for existing saved queries to null. Frontend: small UX tweak and tooltip.

sasha: love it. Also add telemetry keys so we can measure rollback: event saved_query.loaded with attrs {apply_strategy, route_id, model_id, effective_filters_hash}.

dev-console-bot: deploy/stage rollout scheduled: saved-query-apply-strategy feature flag -> 2026-04-02 canary.

jun: test matrix: 1) saved query with model filters + route default overlapping key, 2) saved query global scope, 3) saved query strict vs merged. Make automated e2e for consoles + route snapshots.

marta: UX note: make explicit in save modal: radio for scope + secondary toggle "preserve model-specific filters when switching routes". Keeps users aware.

ryan: ok will draft API contract and add telemetry event names. I'll ping infra for quota implications.

sasha: thanks all. i'll draft the tiny spec and add a couple of sample telemetry charts for the rollout.
